description.raw: '''Innate:''' '''Syndra''' collects Splinters of Wrath that enhance each of her abilities based on the number of them collected, [[File:Stack icon.png|20px|link=Stack|An icon representing the keyword Stack]] [[:Stack|stacking]] up to 120 times. She gains Splinters of Wrath from the following: * Dealing two instances of [[File:Champion ability.svg|20px|link=Champion ability|An icon representing the keyword Champion ability]] [[:Champion ability|ability]] damage to an enemy champion within 4 seconds grants 1 / 2 / 3 (based on level) Splinters. This cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds. * Ranking up an ability with any skill points beyond level 1 grants 5 Splinters, up to 85. * Killing a large minion grants 1 Splinter.
description.text:
Innate: Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath that enhance each of her abilities based on the number of them collected, stacking up to 120 times. She gains Splinters of Wrath from the following:
Dealing two instances of ability damage to an enemy champion within 4 seconds grants 1 / 2 / 3 (based on level) Splinters. This cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds.
Ranking up an ability with any skill points beyond level 1 grants 5 Splinters, up to 85.
Killing a large minion grants 1 Splinter.

description2.raw: Collecting a Splinter of Wrath from an enemy restores [[File:Mana icon.svg|15px|link=Mana]] 20 – 255 (based on level)[[Category:Debug]] mana. Splinters of Wrath are brought to '''Syndra''' from enemies over 0.6 seconds.
description2.text: Collecting a Splinter of Wrath from an enemy restores  20 – 255 (based on level)Category:Debug mana. Splinters of Wrath are brought to Syndra from enemies over 0.6 seconds.

description3.raw: At 120 Splinters of Wrath, '''Syndra''' achieves ''Transcendence'', increasing her [[File:Ability power icon.svg|15px|link=Ability power]] ability power by 15%.
description3.text: At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra achieves Transcendence, increasing her  ability power by 15%.

description4.raw: '''''Syndra''' can collect Splinters of Wrath from enemies even if she is at maximum stacks. These Splinters do not grant any stacks, but will still restore mana for '''Syndra'''.''
description4.text: Syndra can collect Splinters of Wrath from enemies even if she is at maximum stacks. These Splinters do not grant any stacks, but will still restore mana for Syndra.

notes.raw: * '''Syndra's''' abilities gain additional visual effects when they reach their Splinter of Wrath thresholds. Her spells will also gain a red colored tint outlining the VFX. ** ''[[File:Syndra Dark Sphere.png|20xpx|border|link=Syndra#Dark Sphere|An icon for Syndra's ability Dark Sphere]] [[Syndra#Dark Sphere|Dark Sphere]]'' will cause fractures to appear in the earth when it is used.
notes.text:
Syndra's abilities gain additional visual effects when they reach their Splinter of Wrath thresholds. Her spells will also gain a red colored tint outlining the VFX.
* Dark Sphere will cause fractures to appear in the earth when it is used.
